title: Christmas Gift for Daughter: A Story Album From Mom and Dad | Albums.ink
desc: A Christmas gift for your daughter that money can’t buy: a free story album of her years in photos, videos and your own voice, from mom, dad or both.
h1: A Christmas gift for your daughter she will keep coming back to
lead: Type “christmas gift for daughter” into Google in the US and it suggests “from dad”, “from mom” and “who has everything”. Whether she is eight or thirty-eight, one gift that fits every age is her own story: the photos you already have, told in your voice. Here is how to make it for free.
body: ## Why a story album works at any age
- Little girls love seeing themselves as babies and hearing a parent tell the story.
- Teens get something personal instead of another gift card.
- Adult daughters who “have everything” rarely have their childhood in one place.
- It pairs well with a small wrapped gift under the tree.
## What to put in it
- The day she was born and her first Christmas.
- School years: first day of school, recitals, games, prom or graduation.
- Family traditions: decorating the tree, holiday baking, trips to see the grandparents.
- Short videos of her laughing, singing or opening presents years ago.
- A voice note from dad and one from mom: what you are proud of and what you hope for her.
## Chapters that tell her story
1. The day you arrived.
2. Growing up.
3. Our Christmases.
4. What we want you to know.
## How to make it (free)

On Albums you can build a story album from photos, videos and voice notes, split it into chapters and narrate it in your own voice. Albums and posts are unlimited and stay as long as you want them. Free photos are compressed to a maximum of 2048 px on the long edge.
1. Sign in with Google and create an album, for example “For Emma – Christmas 2026”.
2. Pick the best photos and videos and add them chapter by chapter.
3. Record a short voice note for each chapter.
4. To keep it a surprise while you work, set it to Only me.

5. Want dad or mom to add their part? You can add one co-author who is your friend on Albums. Only me hides the album from the co-author too, so while you work together choose Friends, except… and exclude everyone else (check the list again after adding new friends).

## How to give it

On Christmas morning, open the album together on a laptop or tablet. To send her a link, switch the album to Public: public albums open in the browser without signing in and show a cover preview when shared. Friends albums can only be seen by your friends after they sign in, and Only me albums do not open from a link. She can download the whole album as one ZIP file.
